summary: The VerifyLeader interpretation was accepted with the repeat folded in, so that account's central pair now has two executions and its explanation no longer rests on a single run. The one remaining central observation in the submission that still had a single execution is the failed configuration write: the receipt where a store fails exactly the configuration write, the new configuration nevertheless lands in the leader's in-memory latest configuration at the index the entry would have occupied, and the node then counts itself as a quorum and commits entries the committed configuration does not recognise. I requested a repeat of a0f481f52dd0496bba26aafaa8728099-experiment from its retained inputs, which reruns the same cases, admissions and assertions with no code change. An unchanged outcome keeps that account's violated conclusion, its five counterevidence items and seven limitations exactly as recorded while removing the single-run caveat from the observation its defect claim depends on; a changed outcome would directly reopen the premise that the phantom configuration governs elections and commitment. The request validates against the schema and makes no other edits.
